# Brentoljan över 95 dollar – Nokia till Euro Stoxx 50

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-09-02  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon, 2 September 2026. Tension between Iran and the US has pushed Brent crude above $95 and interest rates higher, which is weighing on the market, while US tech reports from Dell and Palo Alto were strong. SB1's Teodor Sverre Nielsen has downgraded Equinor to sell because he expects oil prices to normalise within 6-12 months. Handelsbanken's Daniel Djurberg rates Ericsson a buy and Nokia a hold as Nokia joins the Euro Stoxx 50, and he calls Saab a long-term buy but a hold for now because it is expensive. Nordea's Annika Winsth expects stronger Swedish growth and two Riksbank rate hikes to 2.25%.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🔴 EQNR — Equinor | **SELL** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

SB1 downgraded Equinor to sell because it needs two or more years of $90 oil to justify today's price.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst Teodor Sverre Nielsen (SB1) uses a long-term oil price of $75 based on US shale break-even. Equinor needs at least two years at $90 just to justify its price, with no upside beyond that. He expects the Middle East to normalise within 6-12 months, meaning lower oil, lower gas and lower share prices.

#### Sell Triggers

- Middle East conflict persists beyond 2 years
- Hormuz fully closed, oil sustainably above $90

> *"vi har faktiskt nedgraderat Equinor som är det största oljebolaget i Skandinavien till försäljning"*

---

### 🟢 ERIC-B — Ericsson | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Handelsbanken rates it buy: easier North America comparisons in Q3, AT&T's 600 MHz build-out, and half Nokia's valuation.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst Daniel Djurberg (Handelsbanken) sees Ericsson as better than Nokia short term. Nokia cut its Q3 guidance, while Ericsson faces easy comparisons in North America and gets volume from AT&T's build-out. Its valuation is about half Nokia's. Long-term options are enterprise self-service networks and defence (ISAC/radar), but growth is only 2-3%.

#### Sell Triggers

- Gross margin pressure from the India mix persists
- North America recovery fails to materialise
- Operators keep holding back capex

> *"Vi har på Handelsbanken en köprekommendation på Ericsson."*

---

### 🟡 NOKIA — Nokia | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Handelsbanken rates it hold. It fell about 30% after cutting Q3 guidance; Euro Stoxx 50 inclusion brings index buying.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst Daniel Djurberg (Handelsbanken): Nokia has a stronger growth profile (7-8% from optical and IP) and rose 130% over 12 months. It guided Q3 lower and pushed its outlook to Q4, and its valuation is about double Ericsson's. He prefers Ericsson short term.

#### Sell Triggers

- Further guidance cuts
- AI data-centre demand for optical fades

> *"Vi har en behåll sedan en tid tillbaka på Nokia"*

---

### 🟡 SAAB-B — Saab | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Handelsbanken rates it hold for now because it is expensive, but an easy buy on a 5-year view given Europe's decade-long defence spending build-up.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst Daniel Djurberg: Saab is one of the most expensive defence stocks in the world and momentum-driven short term. Europe's security-policy shift benefits it for about 10 years regardless of peace in Ukraine. He advises patience and waiting for a better entry point; it is a buy on a 5-year horizon.

#### Sell Triggers

- European defence budgets reversed
- Order-to-cash-flow conversion fails

> *"På fem år skulle jag ganska enkelt köpa aktien."*

---

### ⛔ VOLCAR-B — Volvo Cars | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Sales down 7.4% over rolling three months; a tough industry. Host analyst: 'no stock I would jump on'.

#### Reasoning

Host analyst Ture Wester (EFN) sees a challenging car market, with June-August volumes down 7.4% and the stock down 1.5%, and would not buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- Sales volumes recover
- EV mix drives margin improvement

> *"Tuff industri att hålla på i. Ingen aktie jag skulle kasta mig över."*
